children.value: > Fact From Story Epic Games will drag a tech giant into court, alleging that its mobile app store is an illegal monopoly.
> > Fact From Story The short answer: while Epic’s antitrust claims against Apple got their day in court, a similar lawsuit against Google never did.
> > > Fact From Story On November 6th, Epic v. Google will finally go to trial... a mere 1,180 days after Epic originally sued.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge A trial is a type of court proceeding.
> > Commonsense Knowledge A court is a place where trials and other legal cases happen.

> Fact From Story A new class action lawsuit filed this week in the U.S. District Court in D.C. accuses Google and parent company Alphabet of anticompetitive behavior in violation of U.S. antitrust law, the Sherman Act, and others, on behalf of news publishers.

> > Fact From Story The case, filed by Arkansas-based publisher Helena World Chronicle, argues that Google “siphons off” news publishers’ content, their readers and ad revenue through anticompetitive means.
> > Commonsense Knowledge Accusations in lawsuits are claims that a party has engaged in unlawful or harmful behavior.
> Commonsense Knowledge A lawsuit is a legal proceeding brought by one person or entity against another person or entity.
